title: Preview has real prerequisites
when: A browser review needs a temporary deployed target
need: Check ephemeral-env capability and serving support before offering a preview. The Branch Preview Hosting Pack supplies host routing and cleanup; the project owns its deploy workflow and application-specific configuration. It is not provider-neutral instant hosting.
surface: Onboard profile “The delivery box” preview rule; Branch Preview Hosting Pack introduction and project-specific work.
gap: Proposed JOURNEYS branch should offer a supported existing target or preview setup, with unsupported/deferred alternatives visible.
